title: Corporate Hierarchy Influence
description: In a corporate structure, employees are organized in a reporting tree. An employee is considered "influential" if, along the reporting path from the CEO (root) down to that employee, there is no other employee with a strictly higher salary. Given the root of the corporate tree where each node contains an employee's salary, write a function to count the total number of influential employees in the company.
constraints: The number of nodes in the tree is in the range [1, 10^5].
The salary of each employee is an integer between -10^4 and 10^4.
input_format: The root node of the binary tree representing the corporate hierarchy.
output_format: An integer representing the count of influential employees.

examples.explanation: Root node 3 is influential. Node 4 is influential because 4 >= 3. Node 3 in the left subtree is influential because 3 >= 3 and 3 >= 1. Node 5 in the right subtree is influential because 5 >= 4.
Root 3 is influential. Left child 3 is influential. Its left child 4 is influential. The right child 2 is not influential because 3 > 2.
The single root node is always influential.
